sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A maze traverse, not a fight — navigate the shifting castle to reach Xera while managing a stacking madness effect. No gliding here; falling usually means death.

sections.heading: Madness stacks
bullets: Everyone gains Madness stacks over time (1 every 3s) — and it doubles to 2 every 3s if you're looking at the giant rotating statue in the center. Don't stare at it.

Every 10 stacks brings a new effect, and at 99 you die with no exceptions. Fountains scattered through the castle cleanse 10 stacks at a time ("dip your hands") — prefer that over "drink the water," which only pauses the buildup instead of removing it.

sections.heading: Haunting Statues
bullets: They chase anyone who isn't maintaining eye contact with them. You can't damage them, but you can knock, pull, or push them — walking into one teleports you back to the start of the route, so treat them as a hard obstacle, not a fight.

sections.heading: The route
bullets: Clear the starter platform, take the left portal down a damaging staircase, then the southwest portal to a U-shaped platform with mobs.
Dodge off the U-shaped platform onto the lower archway — stay at full health before this jump, it's punishing.
Hit buttons 3 and 4, then head left past statues and White Mantle enemies, jump the rocky sections, and climb the staircases to the final door.
White Mantle enemies here knock back and knock down — watch your footing near platform edges.
